info.name: TryBuy API
info.description:
TryBuy gateway HTTP API (all microservices are TCP-only behind the gateway).

## Switch dev <-> prod
Only two variables control the target host:
- `baseUrl` — prefixed routes, default `http://localhost:3000/api`
- `rootUrl` — un-prefixed routes (health, callbacks, webhook), default `http://localhost:3000`

Edit them on the collection (or import an Environment) — e.g. set `baseUrl` to `https://api.yourdomain.com/api` and `rootUrl` to `https://api.yourdomain.com`.

## Auth
Run **User / Auth > Login** first. It sets the HttpOnly `access_token` cookie; Postman's cookie jar stores it per host and sends it automatically on every request. Set `username` / `password` variables to a real account.

## Path variables
IDs like `{{orderId}}`, `{{productId}}`, `{{userId}}` are collection variables — fill in a real public id (`ord_...`, `prod_...`, `usr_...`) before sending. Numeric-id params (cart items, inventory, brands, categories) take plain integers.

item.name: User / Auth
item.description: Auth uses an HttpOnly cookie set by Login. Run Login first; the cookie jar carries it.
